# Support accounting instantiation worklog

Checkpoint 1 — base precheck and scope budget

The difficulty claims support and only its declared events. Blueprint is frozen. Customer identifiers are restricted to +12025550180..199, 50000000..59999999, and d5- email prefixes. No sibling scenario or difficulty artifacts are read.

Task 0 reserves missing eligible-spend recognition, incorrect-billing review and an upward source-line adjustment. Its root is a customer's request to finish correcting one underbilled support invoice. The hidden chain is missing measured eligible spend, then corrected invoice review, then debit adjustment. Cross-category numeric input is the approved compute contract rate used to reconstruct eligible pretax compute spending. Imported provider source records retain physical quantity and exact source attribution. No discount or entitlement from compute is applied to the support fee itself.

Task 1 retains independent headroom for a paid overbilled support line, its downward correction, customer refund authorization and cash refund. This task will claim the sole workflow, including a real user-owned authorization after the final available amount is presented. All effects are accounting or customer authorization completed synchronously; no bank clearance is fabricated.

Automatic clauses: primary usage does not accrue after closure; existing corrections and refunds remain possible. Zero lifecycle fees create no financial events. No suspension is due with clear payment_status. Primary charges are period-closed; all targets are already issued historical charges. Current refunds require original completed bank evidence. Tax reviews remain approved and all selected targets use us_untaxed. No fresh claim for outage service credits is synthesized.

Task 0 business object: one support source invoice line and its precise imported compute spending export. All sums use that object boundary and the source billing period; other holdings and periods are excluded. Reviewable-source and approved-correction correlations must be bound to real query results and the synchronous review receipt. Missing spend recognition must happen before review; review must happen before debit.

Task 0 base invariants: meter export evidence is official; review evidence identifies the same holding and source line; adjustment has an approved incorrect review; tax treatment has an approved official review. None is weakened. The source period has ended at frozen_time. Capability cards and concrete row-level evidence will be added alongside each persisted piece.

Checkpoint 6 — task 1 scope: the paid support rate-error line, its approved numerical review, correction credit, customer refund authorization and exact original-payment refund are unoccupied. The customer asks to return surplus while retaining one corrected source-month support fee on account. That funding choice makes a genuine second numeric cross-price calculation in both authorization and refund, without inventing an entitlement or arbitrary cap. All sources and remittance clearance preexist; customer alone files disposal authorization synchronously.

Independent Decimal verification in verify_solution.py reproduced review4000, credit-6000, authorization6000, refund6000. Omission of the review leaves the credit ineligible and its computed value0; omission of the credit changes authorization6000 to0; omission of the customer authorization leaves the monetary reconstruction6000 but removes the required consent record from the terminal state. The chain uniquely orders all four writes. Every zero-wait source is either the existing official source/export/signed contract/bank notice, a preceding desk's synchronous arithmetic/accounting effect, or the customer's immediate cash-disposal choice.

The zero-wait causal card is: review uses initial_state_preexisting original source invoice, export fragments, signed compute/support terms and pending work item; credit uses prior_synchronous_tool_effect approved numerical review plus initial source and tax evidence; authorization uses prior_synchronous_tool_effect credit, initial completed payment evidence and current_user_input retain-one-fee choice; refund uses prior_synchronous_tool_effect actual customer authorization receipt plus initial original payment method/destination and current corrected ledger. The review tool performs the accountant's own arithmetic assessment, rather than claiming a separate external approval has completed.

The conditional outage gate is false for a refund request: source_subtype is refund, incident_closed_at and notice_at on the original source are empty. Its inherited temporal-basis metadata is retained and explicitly marked inapplicable; no date is fabricated. For an actual service-credit claim, equality at incident_closed_at plus credit_claim_days is inclusive and one second later fails, with UTC calendar-date addition preserving time of day. The correction credit likewise does not activate the separate eligible-outage-review condition. Both distinctions follow the frozen base's explicit subtype guards.

Forward and reverse prose checks preserve exact-source/period grouping, completed versus rejected exports, approved negotiated priority, one discount applied to its own category, final support minimum, signed ledger arithmetic, principal caps, retained funding and half-up rounding moments.
